Grid alignment and place-items

Grid alignment controls items within their areas; place-items is shorthand for align-items and
justify-items.

Interview question: What is the difference between justify-items and justify-content in Grid?

Answer: justify-items aligns individual items in their areas; justify-content aligns the grid
tracks as a group.
Remember: Items inside cells; content moves tracks.
